name: render_published_pages
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,base64,json
imgs=[]
for page in [1,3,4,5]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-singlefile','-scale-to','1200','-png','sources/critical-journal.pdf'],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
 s=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode()
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','rendered/journal-page-'+str(page)+'.png','--base64'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 imgs.append(s)
print(json.dumps(imgs))
